# CrowdChange Docs (offline mirror)

> Offline Markdown mirror of CrowdChange's two documentation sites: the charity Help Center (https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak), which covers using the platform UI, and the API & developer docs (https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev): REST endpoints, webhooks, widgets and analytics integrations. Built as reference material for a CrowdChange-to-CRM integration. Retrieved 2026-10-14.

Navigation: docs/help-center/INDEX.md and docs/api/INDEX.md (trees, plus an endpoint table for the API), docs/TAGS.md (topics across both). Each collection has a manifest.json with every page's metadata. Every page starts with YAML front matter.

## API & Developer Docs (59 pages)

- [Google Analytics (GA4)](docs/api/pages/analytics/google-analytics.md): Connect CrowdChange to Google Analytics 4 to track pageviews, donation events, and fundraising campaign performance across your site.
- [Google Tag Manager](docs/api/pages/analytics/google-tag-manager.md): Set up Google Tag Manager on CrowdChange to forward donation, checkout, and pageview events to your marketing and analytics tools.
- [Facebook Pixel](docs/api/pages/analytics/facebook-pixel.md): Install the Facebook Pixel and Conversions API in CrowdChange to track donations, retarget visitors, and measure ad performance on Meta.
- [Pinterest](docs/api/pages/analytics/pinterest.md): Add the Pinterest Tag and Conversions API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and donation checkout events from Pinterest ads.
- [Reddit](docs/api/pages/analytics/reddit.md): Add the Reddit Pixel and Conversions API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and donation purchase events from Reddit ads.
- [TikTok](docs/api/pages/analytics/tiktok.md): Add the TikTok Pixel and Events API to CrowdChange to track pageviews, add-to-cart, and completed donation payment events from TikTok ads.
- [Widgets Overview](docs/api/pages/widgets/overview.md): Embed CrowdChange fundraising widgets on your website with a single script tag, then add donation forms, progress bars, and thermometers…
- [Donation Form Widget](docs/api/pages/widgets/donation-form-widget.md): Embed the CrowdChange donation form on your site to accept donations inline or in a popup, with customizable colors, language, and layout.

- [Sign Out All Devices](docs/api/pages/api-reference/server-side/user-specific-apis/post_v2-private-user-logout-all.md): `POST /v2/private/user/logout/all` — Invalidate every active auth token for the authenticated CrowdChange user, signing them out of all devices and sessions in a single call.
